# Changelog

## 2016.8.1-fortran.1

- Initial modern Fortran translation of all exported computational routines
- Added typed real and complex callback interfaces
- Added Richardson, simple, one-sided, and complex-step differentiation
- Added Bates-Watts derivative result type
- Added explicit status reporting and vector-shape validation
- Fixed the upstream `r=1` Richardson indexing limitation
- Added FPM project files, tests, examples, documentation, and validation scripts
